 Order
These two first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. are filed on behalf of applicants for grant of bail pending trial.

The applicants have been arrested in connection with Crime No.654/2022 of Police Station Kotwali District Panna for commission of offence punishable under Section 376(D) of IPC and Section 66(E)
of Information And Technology Act, 2000.
Both the applicants are in detention since 30.09.2022.

As per prosecution story on 29.09.2022, 20 years old prosecutrix filed an application in writing before S.H.O. Kotwali District Panna alleging that three years ago, she was student of B.Sc in Chhatrasal Science College, Panna.
Due to lock-down and Covid Pandemic classes were not being regularly conducted.
She use to come Panna for taking examination.
Since July, 2022, she was living in a rented house at Indrapuri Colony, Panna.
She use to come to her college by auto.
Name of auto driver was Ghanshyam Rajak.
Ghanshyam Rajak had taken her mobile number.
He use to make calls to her telling that he loves her.
After sometime, she stopped attending Ghanshyam Rajak's calls.
Ghanshyam Rajak shared her mobile number with his friends Naveen Balmik and Maan Ali.
Thereafter they both regularly made calls to her and also pressurized to make physical relations with them.
On 28.09.2022 at around 11 A.M. Maan Ali and Naveen Balmik made a call stating that they are reaching near Sahu Aata Chakki in the auto of Maan Ali and from there they would go to visit some places.
She seated in the auto alongwith them.
Auto was being driven by Naveen Balmik.
They took her in the forest of Dehlan Chowki.
In the forest, Maan Ali and Naveen Balmik committed rape upon her.
Thereafter, they brought her back and at around 1.30 P.M. dropped her near her rented room.

Same day at around 5.00 P.M., Maan Ali again made a call and pressurized her to go with him, when she refused his demand, after sometime Ghanshyam Rajak made a call and asked her to go alongwith him at Kishoriji Temple.
In the meantime, she heard the voice of Maan Ali stating that they have prepared her rape video and they will make the same viral.
Having no option, she went near Satna barrier where Maan Ali and Ghanshyam Rajak were standing on a motorcycle.

They again took her in the forest where Maan Ali again attempted to commit rape upon her but she did not allow him thereafter Ghanshyam Rajak forcibly committed rape upon her and dropped her near Sahu Aata Chakki.
In the night too, they repeatedly made calls but she did not attend their calls.
Thereafter, she narrated the story to her sister Shilpi and 1-2 other persons.
F.I.R. was registered.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicants have submitted that applicants have not committed any offence.
They are innocent.
They have been falsely implicated.
No video of rape has been seized from them.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant Ghanshyam Rajak submits that there is no legal and admissible evidence against Ghanshyam Rajak.
Prosecutrix was earlier having love affairs with Ghanshyam Rajak but later-on he snapped ties with the prosecutrix, therefore, prosecutrix has falsely implicated applicant Ghanshyam Rajak.
Learned counsel for the applicant Maan Ali @ Manu has submitted that the story is manufactured.
He has been falsely enroped in the offence.
No video has been seized.
In medical examination no injury has been found on her person.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicants be released on bail pending the trial.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicants.
I have gone through the prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C and her complaint in writing.
F.I.R has been lodged immediately on the next date of incident i.e on 30.09.2022.
Blood samples alongwith other material have been sent for DNA profiling.

Having taking into consideration the specific allegations made against the present applicants, namely,
Ghanshyam Rajak and Maan Ali @ Manu, I am not inclined to release the applicants on bail.
Therefore, the first bail applications under section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by applicant Ghanshyam Rajak and applicant Maan Ali @ Manu are dismissed.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE MKL Maan Ali @ Manu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4630855/
